### Understanding Rugby

Rugby is a sport that is primarily popular in Europe. Union rugby (the type this data is from) is played by 15 players on the pitch from each team. The pitch is roughly the size of an American Football field and has goalposts (similar to in football) on either side of the field. These goalposts lie on the “try line”. The goal of the teams is to get the ball past their respective try line, as doing so will score them 7 points.

### United Rugby Championship

The United Rugby Championship (URC) is a global league of 16 club teams from around the world. The championship is tournament style and split into 18 matches with knock-out stages leading to the final.

## Data

The `rugby.csv` data set includes data from all.rugby about the make-up of each of the teams in the United Rugby Championships.

<details>

<summary><b>Variable Descriptions</b></summary>

| Variable    | Description                                  |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Name        | Player name (First LAST)                     |
| Position    | Player position (Scrum-Half, Winger, etc.)   |      
| Age         | Player age                                   |
| Birthdate   | Player birthdate (dd/mm/yyyy)                |
| Height      | Player height (meters)                       |
| Weight      | Player weight (kg)                           |
| Height_ft   | Player height (ft in)                        |
| Weight_lb   | Player weight (lb)                           |
| Contract    | Player contract type (PRO or ACADEMY)        |
| Length      | Player contract end year                     |
| Team        | Player team in the URC                       | 

</details>

Download [URCplayers.csv](URCplayers.csv){target="_blank"}
